bullets: Megacap tech selloff (Alphabet -13%, Intel -21%, ServiceNow -27% worst days) dragged Nasdaq futures -1.6%, but Health/Energy/Staples/Utilities rallied, masking broad risk-off.
Chevron and ExxonMobil report Q3 earnings before Friday's open; Brent near $111 keeps energy sentiment firm.
US 10Y yield near 4.99%, Dollar soft -0.16%; Employment Cost Index (medium impact) due 8:30am ET today.
Bitcoin -4.1% and Circle/Tether freezing funds tied to a Binance security issue add overnight crypto-market stress.

MOH.why: Oct 23 Q3 report showed net income halved, medical cost ratio above guidance, falling membership, and trimmed 2027 premium guidance. Analysts kept Neutral/Equal-Weight ratings but raised price targets. Company-specific earnings damage, not sector-wide (Health sector sentiment positive).
MOH.bull: Management reaffirmed $5.25 EPS guidance, calling margins a cyclical trough ahead of 2027 Medicaid rate increases.
MOH.bear: Q3 net income halved, membership keeps shrinking, and 2027 premium guidance was trimmed — real fundamental damage.

sources.title: Molina Healthcare (MOH) Stock Drops After Q3 Results Expose Margin Squeeze
MOH Q3 deep dive: Medicaid margin stabilization and rate cycle drive cautious optimism

CRM.why: CRM fell with Tech/Software after ServiceNow's 19% post-earnings crash sparked sector-wide SaaS demand-growth fears. No CRM-specific guidance cut found; DA Davidson and Cantor Fitzgerald moves this month were price-target raises, not downgrades.
CRM.bull: Drop is sector contagion from ServiceNow's contract slowdown, not a CRM-specific issue; two analysts raised targets this week.
CRM.bear: If enterprise software demand is genuinely decelerating sector-wide, CRM's own growth could disappoint next quarter too.

sources.title: ServiceNow Tumbles 19% as Slower Contract Growth Overshadows Raised AI Target; Salesforce Slides 6%, Workday Drops 5%

GDDY.why: GDDY beat Q3 estimates and reaffirmed revenue guidance, but forward ARR growth guidance decelerated to 4.9% and an active securities-fraud lawsuit over undisclosed domain-discounting remains open. Cantor Fitzgerald downgraded to Neutral ahead of earnings (Oct 19).
GDDY.bull: Q3 beat on revenue and EPS with reaffirmed full-year guidance; GAAP EPS topped estimates by $0.18.
GDDY.bear: Active securities-fraud lawsuit over domain discounting plus decelerating 4.9% ARR growth guidance signal real company-specific damage.

sources.title: LAWSUIT ALERT: GoDaddy Inc. (NYSE: GDDY) Investors Should Contact the Shareholders Foundation

WEX.why: WEX beat Q3 estimates and raised full-year revenue/EPS guidance, yet shares fell amid sector-wide payments selling and analyst concern about slower embedded-payments/Benefits pipeline realization. No fraud, lawsuit, downgrade, or guidance cut found.
WEX.bull: WEX beat Q3 and raised full-year guidance meaningfully, with no negative company-specific news found.
WEX.bear: Stock fell despite beat-and-raise amid sector-wide payments selling and concern over slower pipeline realization.

sources.title: WEX's (NYSE:WEX) Q3 2026: strong sales, full-year sales guidance is optimistic

ADP.why: ADP beat Q1 FY2027 estimates, raised full-year revenue and EPS guidance, and drew price-target hikes from Stifel/Citi. Drop looks like 'sell the news' profit-taking after a rich ~25x P/E run-up, not fundamental damage or a sector move.
ADP.bull: ADP beat, raised FY2027 guidance, and drew multiple analyst price-target hikes — fundamentals improved, drop looks like profit-taking.
ADP.bear: Entering earnings at a rich 25x P/E after a strong run, any in-line print risked a 'sell the news' reaction.
